summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies furnished a 6-K on September 18, 2026, posting an updated corporate presentation covering its acquisition of LightSolver, a high-performance computing technology company. The disclosure followed a September 17 investor webinar. Consideration includes closing shares plus pre-funded warrants, with $5 million in funding to LightSolver and subsequent milestone payments, though no price per share or total value was stated. CollPlant will provide the public-company platform for commercialization while evaluating strategic alternatives for its existing biotech assets. What to watch: transaction completion, Nasdaq listing compliance, integration risk, and financing adequacy.
